name: viewfinder
description: Inspect, debug, profile, and automate Iris shaders in a running Minecraft client.

interface.shortDescription: Debug a live Iris shaderpack from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Viewfinder's local MCP server to inspect shader diagnostics, GPU resources, programs, passes, and controlled singleplayer scenes.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the active Iris shaderpack and prioritize its errors.
Profile 60 frames and identify the slowest shader passes.
Capture the output of a shader pass and analyze it.
